1. (previously presented) An aircraft seat, comprising:- a seat chassis;
- a seat assembly comprising a seat pan, a seat back, and a leg rest;
- the seat pan being mounted to the seat chassis by a first pivoting connection defining a seat pan pivot axis about which the seat pan pivots, the location of the seat pan pivot axis being fixed relative to the seat chassis;
- the leg rest being mounted to said seat pan by a pivoting connection defining a leg rest pivot axis about which the leg rest pivots;
- at least one seat pan link for controlling pivoting of the seat pan about said seat pan pivot axis; and
- at least one leg rest link connected to the leg rest and the at least one seat pan link;
- wherein the at least one seat pan link is coupled to the seat pan in front of the seat pan pivot axis.

59. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 1, wherein the seat chassis comprises:- at least one seat pan track; and
- at least one seat pan follower adapted to travel in said at least one seat pan track, the at least one seat pan follower being connected to the at least one seat pan link.
60. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 1, wherein the seat back is mounted to said seat pan by a second pivoting connection, the second pivoting connection defining a seat back pivot axis about which the seat back pivots.
61. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 60, wherein said seat pan pivot axis is located in front of the seat back pivot axis; and the seat pan pivot axis is located between the seat back pivot axis and a mid-point of the seat pan.
62. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 60, comprising at least one recline link coupled to the seat back.
63. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 62, wherein the at least one recline link is connected to the at least one seat pan link.
64. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 63, wherein the at least one aircraft seat pan link, the at least one recline link, and the at least one leg rest link connect the seat pan, the seat back and the leg rest such that adjusting an incline angle of the seat pan changes a recline angle of the seat back and a deployment angle of the leg rest.
65. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 1, wherein the leg rest is extendible.
66. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 1, comprising:- at least one leg rest track; and
- at least one leg rest follower adapted to travel in said at least one leg rest track, the at least one leg rest follower being connected to said at least one leg rest link.
67. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 1, comprising a leg rest decoupling mechanism operable selectively to decouple the leg rest link from the leg rest.
68. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 65, wherein the leg rest comprises a base portion and an extending portion, the extending portion being movable relative to the base portion to extend the leg rest.
69. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 68, wherein the leg rest comprises a cam track and a cam follower for controlling movement of the extending portion.
70. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 69, wherein the cam follower is disposed on a pivotally mounted arm.
71. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 69, wherein the cam track comprises at least one recess for retaining the extending portion in an extended position, wherein each recess comprises an aperture for receiving the cam follower to retain the extending portion in the extended position.
72. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 71, comprising cam follower biasing means for biasing the cam follower into the aperture.
73. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 68, comprising extending portion biasing means for biasing the extending portion towards the base portion.
74. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 73, wherein the extending portion biasing means comprises at least one tension gas spring.
75. (previously presented) An aircraft seat as claimed in claim 65, wherein the at least one leg rest link coupled to the leg rest controls extension of the leg rest.
76. (previously presented) An aircraft comprising one or more aircraft seat as claimed in claim 1.
77. (new) An aircraft seat, comprising:- a seat chassis;
- a seat assembly comprising a seat pan and a seat back;
- the seat pan being mounted to the seat chassis by a first pivoting connection defining a seat pan pivot axis about which the seat pan pivots, the location of the seat pan pivot axis being fixed relative to the seat chassis, the first pivoting connection being configured such that the seat pan can pivot about the seat pan pivot axis without undergoing a related translational movement;
- the seat back being mounted to the seat pan by a second pivoting connection, the second pivoting connection defining a seat back pivot axis about which the seat back pivots, the seat pan pivot axis being positioned in front of the seat back pivot axis; and
- at least one seat pan link for controlling pivoting of the seat pan about said seat pan pivot axis; wherein the at least one seat pan link is coupled to the seat pan in front of the seat pan pivot axis;
- a recline link connected to the seat back and the at least one seat pan link; and
- wherein the seat pan pivot axis is positioned between the seat back pivot axis and a mid-point of the seat pan.
